# Rights

Named rights: each one is stated once, and every lifecycle that uses it says in which of its states it holds.

## OwnerKeptWhileFrozen

A frozen record keeps its owner.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Name | `OwnerKeptWhileFrozen` |
| Allows or denies | denies |
| Who | everyone |
| Does | `change-owner` |
| While frozen | holds only while the object is frozen |
| Used by | [EmployeeRecord](processes/employee-record.md) (all states) |
